newsitem.title: USA: U.S. mortgage-backeds slip modestly on Wednesday.
newsitem.headline: U.S. mortgage-backeds slip modestly on Wednesday.

text.p: U.S. mortgage-backed securities slipped lightly on Wednesday, with spreads narrowing to Treasuries early in the day but moving back toward unchanged in the afternoon.

Pass-throughs were up modestly overall soon after the market opened but turned negative before midday. Treasuries moved in similar fashion, with the 10-year note off 2/32 late on Wednesday, slightly off its lows for the day.
Mortgage-backeds remained range-bound with no data to digest during the session.
Analysts said much of the day's negative sentiment arose from expectations the August employment report could show a sharp rise in jobs creation when it is released September 6.
Weak response to Wednesday's auction of five-year Treasury notes affected the market little, Treasury analysts said.
Late Wednesday afternoon, Ginnie Mae 30-year 8.0 percent coupons were off 2/32 at 100-20/32, yielding 118 basis points over 10-year Treasuries.
Comparable FNMAs were off 1/32 at 100-18/32, and FHLMCs were off 1/32 at 100-20/32.
